# CaptureBrief font sources

The glossy CaptureBrief release self-hosts these open-source variable fonts:

- Newsreader — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Familjen Grotesk — SIL Open Font License 1.1
- Azeret Mono — SIL Open Font License 1.1

Files were obtained from the corresponding Fontsource packages through jsDelivr
on September 23, 2026 and are stored under `assets/fonts/`. They are used only by
the CaptureBrief-scoped stylesheet.
